---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or improvement for the plugin
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What is hard or impossible today, and in which deployment (Web / Desktop /
headless tool)?

## Proposed solution

The behavior you would like, including the panel/route/tool surface it would
touch if you have a preference.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches, workarounds, or why a simpler change would be enough.

## Privacy and safety

Does the request touch session content, workspace files, deletion, imports,
network fetching or credentials? Note any risk the maintainer should design for
(for example a destructive action that needs a second confirmation).

> Do not include real session logs, credentials, tokens, absolute user paths or
> unsanitized screenshots. Report security issues via [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
